reasoning_content: I keep having issues with quoting in Python. Let me simplify this - I'll just use a simple file copy from the git clone.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")


# Copy the package.json from git clone in local
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['cat', '/workspace/project/wasd-clone/package.json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
local_pkg = result.stdout

# Add type module
local_pkg = local_pkg.replace('"private": true', '"private": true,\n  "type": "module"')

# Upload
sftp = client.open_sftp()
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/package.json", "w") as f:
    f.write(local_pkg)
print("Uploaded package.json with type:module")

# Also for server
result = subprocess.run(['cat', '/workspace/project/wasd-clone/server/package.json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
local_server_pkg = result.stdout
local_server_pkg = local_server_pkg.replace('"private": true', '"private": true,\n  "type": "module"')

with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/server/package.json", "w") as f:
    f.write(local_server_pkg)
print("Uploaded server/package.json with type:module")
sftp.close()

# Build and start
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && node server/dist/index.js &")
print("Started")

import time
time.sleep(8)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health")
print("\nHealth:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
